sources: https://tnstateparks.com/parks/reelfoot-lake/camping (read 2026-11-24): 'Reelfoot Lake South Campground ... located on Tennessee Highway 21-22, on the south end of Reelfoot Lake. There are paved RV and tent campsites. Sites have 20-, 30-, and 50-amp electrical hookups, as well as water hookups. There are three bathhouses with restrooms. Two bathhouses have hot showers and one has a washer, dryer, and dishwashing area. There is a dump station located at the entrance.' 'Please note: The South Campground is extremely busy during April and May.' 'Some campsites are located directly along the lakeshore.' 'Campground Hosts are available at the South Campground.' 'The Check-in Station is located in the Camp Store.'

https://tnstateparks.com/parks/reelfoot-lake (read 2026-11-24): Park office 2595 Highway 21, phone 1-731-253-9652; Park Camp Store 6812 Hwy 21 W, phone 1-731-538-3356, 'Seasonal. Please call for more information.'; alerts: Eagle Basin Day Use Area closed from June 12, 2026; Long Park partly closed from October 19 for pier reconstruction (~12 weeks); Blue Bank and Eagle Basin day-use renovations to February 2027 - none names the South Campground

https://reserve.tnstateparks.com/reelfoot-lake/campsites (Calendar View by plain POST, two weeks from each of 2026-11-25, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-05-25, 2027-06-29, 2027-09-01, 2027-10-12; read 2026-11-24): South Campsites 1-86 less 31 (85) and South Primitive Campsites 1-5 ('This is a primitive campsite. RVs are not permitted on this site.'); every attributed RV site water + 30/50 A on concrete, sewer at 56 (15 'A+' premium), 13 pull-throughs, max RV 38-115 ft; standard water/electric $31-47, sewer sites $39-63, premium $39-68, primitive $14-24; nearly every site offered in the January 2027 window. The same calendar also holds Airpark Campsites 1-14 (separate entry 4410)

Esri World Imagery (sat.py 36.3542,-89.3962 half 350 m, read 2026-11-24): the pin sits at the camp store/entrance on Hwy 21; the loops spread ~100-300 m west of it on the south shore, the north row of pads ~25-45 m from the cypress-fringed lake edge

values.note: Water/electric sites $31-47 a night, sewer sites $39-63, the 15 premium sites up to $68, plus tax and a $5 reservation fee per site; higher on weekends and busy dates. The primitive tent sites are $14-24. Every bookable night on the park's reservation calendar for two weeks from 2026-11-25, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-05-25, 2027-06-29, 2027-09-01 and 2027-10-12, read 2026-11-24.

summary: Reelfoot Lake State Park South Campground confirmed: 85 paved RV sites (water + 30/50 A, sewer at 56, 13 pull-through, to 115 ft) + 5 primitive tent sites; $31-68 (stored $32-56); year-round; showers, laundry, dump, camp store. --AWH lakefront consistent with imagery. Phone 731-253-8003 not found on any park page.
